dedupe_keys.name: hungarian vhf and uhf amateur radio repeater list ha2to

description: The HA2TO site publishes what it describes as the official and most up-to-date list of Hungarian VHF and UHF amateur radio repeaters, updated daily when needed, with a change list, CTCSS zones and a separate beacon list. The list is split by operating mode, with analogue, C4FM, DMR and other modes shown in separate tables, and switched-off or closed repeaters are kept with an inactive flag. Each row gives the call sign, site or name, downlink and uplink frequencies in kHz, new and old channel names, offset, mode, CTCSS tones, Echolink node, Maidenhead locator, altitude and status; for example HG0RUA at Debrecen on 438625.0 and 431025.0 kHz, FM and C4FM, active. DMR repeaters also carry their DMR ID and colour code, and one entry is an emergency repeater. Changes are made only on notice from the licence holders and operators. Access is free, and the page allows reuse of the data on other websites if the source and the date of the list are shown. Caveats: the page warns that listed data can differ from the real settings, and the Echolink status may be out of date. Coverage is Hungary. It supports emergency communications planning with backup radio relays; related records are the ÖVSV repeater, digipeater and beacon database and the 9A repeater tables of Croatia.
